title: Define the Mez Systems Trading Card and full-field expression
objective: Define what a Mez Systems trading card means, prove one adaptable full-field product-object language across single cards, information backs, decks, packs and realistic website placements, and separate useful product architecture from decorative collector styling.

included: portrait trading-card master and bounded square or landscape full-field adaptations
front-face identity hierarchy and information-back hierarchy
single, pair, stack, fan, pack and five-product family relationships
static and automatic Living Core twins with one live allocation per viewport
atomic keep, revise, kill and written feedback for every specimen and family
excluded: rarity, scarcity, numbered runs, founder foil, archive codes or fake statistics
new product names, gradients, Wings geometry or Living Core palettes
commerce pricing, checkout logic or payment-provider integration
production consumer migration, Figma or channel packs

acceptance: one schema-validated canonical contract defines meaning, anatomy, formats, motion, stacks, omissions and the closed human gate
canonical 1.0.0 and bounded production authority remain explicit
twenty-three approved specimens preserve 22 champions and rebuild only TC-P06 as named in the Round 02 receipt
TC-F06 and TC-P04 are absent alongside all earlier killed directions
static and automatic twins are directly comparable while only one core moves
the locked workbench preserves the 23 unanimous keeps and canonical approval record
the workbench clearly distinguishes the approved Trading Card expression from the killed Product Card editions

verification.passCondition: exactly 23 approved specimens render across 4 faces, 4 backs, 8 decks and 7 placements
the immutable Round 02 receipt records 22 keep, 1 revise and 2 kill; every champion and the single rebuild are present and both killed directions are absent
canonical products, Wings, foundations, Product Card visual grammar and Living Core assets remain unchanged and attributable
the focal full-field material is alive by default, repeated objects are static and reduced-motion or WebGL failure preserves exact static twins
the card feels like a useful Mez product object rather than fake collectible styling or a generic SaaS card
portrait cards, decks and placements remain legible without horizontal page overflow at 320 through 1440 pixels
Olli kept all 23 Round 03 specimens; H-EXP-05-TRADING-CARD-PROOF is closed by DEC-TRADING-CARD-EXPRESSION-001

humanGate.approvalQuestion: Which card faces, information backs, decks and real placements make the full-field product object feel distinctly Mez, useful and worthy of promotion?

stopConditions: a candidate reintroduces numbered editions, founder foil, rarity ladders or fake archive language
a candidate mutates canonical product identity, Wings, gradient assignment, renderer or foundations
a stack becomes decorative overlap without a product relationship
the task expands into pricing, checkout, golden homepage, Figma, channels or consumer migration
candidate work is presented as canonical before the human gate
notes: The historical full-bleed 3:4 card and FUT teardown are evidence only. Their fake collector and rarity mechanics are not authority.
Round 01 deliberately separated front identity, useful information backs, product relationships and real placements so feedback identified what the expression is for.
Round 02 applied the exact 13 keep, 12 revise and 5 kill Round 01 receipt without widening the programme.
Round 03 applies the exact 22 keep, 1 revise and 2 kill Round 02 receipt; TC-F06 and TC-P04 are removed and TC-P06 alone is rebuilt with an explicit five-position deck.
Olli kept all 23 Round 03 specimens. review.json and round-03-feedback.json preserve the approval; canonical Trading Card 01 version 1.0.0 closes EXP-05.
